pages.text: $(bold)Obtaining$() (Iron's Spells crossover): craft it directly in the $(bold)Part Builder$() from the mod's $(bold)Arcane Cloth$() ($(bold)irons_spellbooks:magic_cloth$()) - $(bold)1 ingredient per binding / 2 per maille$() (part costs come from Tinkers: tool_binding=1, maille=2)$(br2)Usable for: $(bold)binding / maille$()$(br2)Tier: $(bold)T1$() (slightly above wood, T0)$(br2)Note: bindings and maille are $(bold)statless parts$() in Tinkers' Construct (they carry traits only), so the difference between these cloth/hide materials is entirely in their $(bold)traits$().

$(bold)Traits$():$(li)$(bold)Arcane Conduction$() (leveled): all $(bold)spell / witchcraft / curse damage +5% per level$() (true damage excluded)$(br2)$(italic)The runes are woven in, not stitched on.$()
